request.prompt: Create exactly one isolated full-body Geth Stalker from the original Mass Effect 1 using these two actual in-game reference images. Reference 1 controls the active wall-clinging pose, orientation, proportions and visible overlaps: two very long upper limbs spread upward/outward, one hind limb bent outward at image left and the other extending lower at image right, the long narrow head pointing diagonally down and toward the viewer. Reference 2 is anatomical corroboration only: use it to identify the real blue optic without the firing effect and to confirm the complete narrow articulated fingers and toe tips, blue internal fibers, black-on-white mottled camouflage and joint connections. Do not use the fallen pose of reference 2. Match the original angular slender game model, dark tapered forearms/shins, pale camouflaged upper plates, thin splayed digits and visible blue core. Remove the red beam and firing flare from reference 1, showing the small blue optic supported by reference 2; no weapon barrel or other invented part. Preserve the reference model's anatomy and finger arrangement without extra limbs, extra eyes, new armor, smooth human hands, or redesigned camouflage. Enlarge the canvas around the original pose so the entire upper-right fingertips and all other toes, head and extremities fit with at least 10 percent transparent margin on every side. Retain natural overlap of the rear leg; do not rearrange the body into a different stance. Restrained original-game surface detail, crisp silhouette, one complete subject in one view. Transparent background with real alpha. No wall, floor, shadow, platform, beam, long lens flare, text, border, sheet or collage. Preserve only a small contained blue light at the optic and the existing exposed blue internal fibers.

notes: Source principale en posture accrochée : doigt supérieur touche le cadre, optique et jambe partiellement masquées par rayon.
Capture complémentaire Noveria réellement inspectée : optique bleue sans rayon, doigts entiers, palette noir-blanc et fibres bleues confirmées.
La deuxième vue sert à lever ces lacunes; la pose au sol n'est pas retenue. Aucune image Prima de préproduction utilisée.
